question: Which trials belong to the anifrolumab TULIP-1 program?
cypher: MATCH (p:ClinicalTrialProgram {id:'P19'})-[r:has_trial]->(t:ClinicalTrial) RETURN t.id AS trial, t.acronym AS acronym, t.status AS status, t.why_stopped AS why_stopped, t.phase AS phase, r.id AS evidence ORDER BY trial LIMIT 50

question: What was the primary outcome of TULIP-1 and its statistical analysis?
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial {id:'NCT:NCT02446912'})-[r:has_outcome_measure]->(o:OutcomeMeasure) WHERE o.kind = 'PRIMARY' RETURN o.name AS outcome, o.time_frame AS time_frame, o.analyses AS analyses, r.id AS evidence ORDER BY outcome LIMIT 50

question: What happened after the TULIP-1 failure?
cypher: MATCH (p:ClinicalTrialProgram {id:'P19'})-[r:has_post_failure_analysis|has_repurposing_pivot]->(e:DevelopmentEvent) RETURN e.id AS event, type(r) AS relation, e.pivot_decision AS decision, e.outcome_evidence AS outcome, e.what_changed AS what_changed, r.id AS evidence ORDER BY event LIMIT 50

question: Which proteins does mepolizumab target?
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug {id:'CHEMBL:CHEMBL2108429'})-[r:interacts_with]->(t) RETURN t.id AS target, t.name AS target_name, r.moa AS mechanism, r.chembl_action_type AS action, r.id AS evidence ORDER BY target LIMIT 50

question: Which drugs were given in the METREO trial and in which role?
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial {id:'NCT:NCT02105961'})-[r:tests_intervention|has_comparator_drug|has_background_drug]->(d:Drug) RETURN d.id AS drug, d.name AS name, type(r) AS role, r.arm_types AS arm_types, r.id AS evidence ORDER BY role, drug LIMIT 50

question: What publications report the dal-GenE trial?
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial {id:'NCT:NCT02525939'})-[r:has_publication]->(p:Publication) RETURN p.id AS pmid, p.title AS title, p.year AS year, r.reference_type AS reference_type, r.id AS evidence ORDER BY pmid LIMIT 200

question: What were the serious adverse events and deaths per arm in METREO?
cypher: MATCH (p:ClinicalTrialProgram)-[r:has_trial]->(t:ClinicalTrial {id:'NCT:NCT02105961'}) RETURN t.ae_groups AS adverse_event_groups, t.ae_time_frame AS time_frame, r.id AS evidence LIMIT 10

question: Which failed programs share a drug target?
cypher: MATCH (p1:ClinicalTrialProgram)-[r1:has_intervention]->(d1:Drug)-[r2:interacts_with]->(t)<-[r3:interacts_with]-(d2:Drug)<-[r4:has_intervention]-(p2:ClinicalTrialProgram) WHERE p1.id < p2.id RETURN t.id AS target, t.name AS target_name, p1.id AS program_1, p2.id AS program_2, r1.id AS e1, r2.id AS e2, r3.id AS e3, r4.id AS e4 ORDER BY target LIMIT 200

question: What was the primary outcome of METREO?
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial {id:'NCT:NCT02105961'})-[r:has_outcome_measure]->(o:OutcomeMeasure) WHERE o.kind = 'PRIMARY' RETURN o.name AS outcome, o.time_frame AS time_frame, o.analyses AS analyses, r.id AS evidence ORDER BY outcome LIMIT 50

question: Which trials are in the dalcetrapib dal-GenE program?
cypher: MATCH (p:ClinicalTrialProgram {id:'P25'})-[r:has_trial]->(t:ClinicalTrial) RETURN t.id AS trial, t.acronym AS acronym, t.status AS status, t.why_stopped AS why_stopped, t.phase AS phase, r.id AS evidence ORDER BY trial LIMIT 50
